verdict: Paid returns dropped sharply this week; two issues are being fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days your Meta ads delivered $7,148.81 in revenue from $1,485.91 in spend, a 4.81 return on ad spend overall — but the most recent 7 days tell a harder story: spend rose 28.1% while return on ad spend fell 70.18% and purchases dropped 21.43%, meaning each dollar spent is producing significantly less than it was the week before. The primary driver is your top campaign, which has absorbed 56% of total spend and shown clear signs of audience fatigue over the last three days. Separately, your Google Business Profile went dark for four consecutive days (Sep 7–10), cutting off the organic traffic pipeline that had been averaging 26 actions per day — that is being investigated and restored. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to relieve campaign fatigue, and five project milestones that were due by August 31 are being prioritized for closure. Once the profile is back online and creative is rotated, both the paid and organic pipelines should stabilize heading into next week.

watch_item.issue: Top ad campaign is showing audience fatigue — purchases fell to 1 in the last 3 days after reaching a high of 5 in the prior 3-day window.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed this week and spend is being pulled back on the fatigued audience to stabilize returns.
